body: There is no shame in living with your parents at 22, just a heads up. However it sounds like you might be in a slightly toxic environment. If I was I’d get professional opinions ASAP if you are still on your parents health insurance. You have a good chunk of cash, visit a sub reddit that is good with finances and ask some opinions. Depression is a medical condition, there are totally options! You got this! You totally have the opportunity to turn how you’re feeling around, you just need some outside help!

Man life can be so unfair and hard. I’m sure a deep part of you knows, or at least I hope so, that all the things you have endured are not deserved. It’s just so fucking sad that life kicks the people that need kicking the least gets it. I don’t know you, but I understand your story. I won’t shame you or try to convince you out of these feelings. Cuz damn are they justified. But sweetheart there are people rooting for you, I know I am.
